warnings: 'ชั้นล่าง' here means the ground/stilt-level beam grid (open under-floor level of this single-story-on-stilts house), not a second story — see grid-master warnings.

Beam mark B3X runs south from C1 to grid line C" (6.60). No dimension is printed for it on this sheet, but a pixel scan of this PNG puts the south edge of the B3X/S0 landing pad exactly 1.20m below row C (189 px at the sheet's own 157.4 px/m, calibrated on grid1-grid3 = 5.40m and A-B = 3.60m) — the same 1.20m that S-05 prints for the balcony/stair-landing edge. So C" is a measurement on this sheet, not an inference borrowed from S-05, and span_source was upgraded from 'unresolved' to 'grid_table' on 2026-08-26 after Makham queried it.

NOT C' — C' (6.40) is the ROOF EAVE line, 1.00m south of C, and comes from the roof plans S-07/S-08 (หน้า25/26). It has nothing to do with the floor structure: no floor beam or slab stops on it. The two dummy lines are 0.20m apart and easy to confuse, so every floor-level element south of C uses C" and every roof-level one uses C'.

S0 markers at the 4 interior bays carry no plan-level dimension beyond the beam grid that bounds them (each bay is exactly one grid module) — grid_refs given as the bounding beam intersection points per bay.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'beam_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 13 beam-family elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
